No install-prompt banner visible on desktop before a beforeinstallprompt event — DOM query for [data-testid*=install]/[class*=install]/[id*=install] returned zero visible elements. Homepage image count is 3 (logo mark + a couple). Reporting these as preview-only per instructions.
